# GitHub Actions Workflows

This directory contains the CI, package publication, and wiki workflows for the Acontplus .NET libraries monorepo.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Purpose | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `build-test.yml` | Restores, builds, tests, validates package versions, packs, and uploads Cobertura coverage artifacts. | Pull requests to `main`/`develop` and manual runs |
| `smart-publish.yml` | Publishes the package versions prepared in a merged release PR. | Merged pull request to `main` that changes a package `<Version>` |
| `version-check.yml` | Compares local package versions with NuGet.org and reports unpublished versions. | Daily and manual |
| `publish-wiki.yml` | Publishes `docs/wiki` to GitHub Wiki. | Changes to wiki documentation |

## Release Flow

1. Update the released package `<Version>` values in `src/**/*.csproj`.
2. Update the matching internal package versions in `Directory.Packages.props`.
3. When an Acontplus dependency changes, update every affected consumer reference and bump that consumer in the same PR.
4. Open a PR to `main` or `develop`. `build-test.yml` validates the entire solution and uploads code coverage artifacts.
5. Review and merge the PR to `main`.
6. `smart-publish.yml` builds, tests, packs, and publishes every changed package version. It verifies NuGet indexing and creates a GitHub Release.

The publishing workflow does not edit versions, create release branches, or infer missing dependent releases after merge. The reviewed PR is the release manifest. Protect `main` and `develop` so changes reach them through pull requests; CI intentionally does not run on direct pushes.

## NuGet Trusted Publishing

`smart-publish.yml` publishes with OIDC:

- The publish job grants `id-token: write`.
- `NuGet/login@v1` exchanges the GitHub Actions identity token for a short-lived NuGet API key.
- The temporary key is used only for `dotnet nuget push`.

Configure the NuGet Trusted Publishing policy for this repository, workflow file `smart-publish.yml`, and the `production` environment. Add `NUGET_USER` as the NuGet.org profile-name secret. Do not configure or rotate a repository `NUGET_API_KEY` for this flow.

See the [official NuGet Trusted Publishing documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/nuget/nuget-org/trusted-publishing) and the [Smart Publish Guide](../../docs/wiki/Smart-Publish-Guide.md).

## Coverage Artifacts

`build-test.yml` discovers `tests/**/*.Tests.Unit.csproj`, executes each project with Microsoft Testing Platform code coverage enabled, and uploads Cobertura XML files for 14 days. Publishing workflows upload the coverage generated by the matching test project when one exists.

Coverage is retained as a GitHub Actions artifact; it is not sent to a third-party coverage service.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Publish workflow did not start | Confirm the merged PR changed a versioned `src/**/*.csproj` package project. |
| Restore fails in CI | Ensure central versions and all released consumer references are included in the same PR. |
| Trusted Publishing login fails | Confirm the NuGet policy names `smart-publish.yml` and, if configured, `production`. |
| Version already exists | Bump to a new SemVer version and merge a new PR. |
| Coverage artifact is absent | Verify the package has a matching `*.Tests.Unit.csproj` and that its tests completed. |
